newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates slide, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates slide, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates dipped on Wednesday with most spinners keeping to the sidelines on hopes that increased supplies from Punjab province would push prices lower, dealers said.
"Higher supplies and recent rains have watered down concerns about the health of the crop," dealer Mustafa Hussain said.
Rates might soften further as most spinners have opted to wait before cutting new deals, he added.
In the kerb market, rates for NIAB-78 was quoted at around 2,150 rupees ($58.01) per maund (37.32 kg).
